meta.title: Roadmap
meta.description: What is live on People's Blockchain today, what we are building next, and what is planned but not yet approved.

intro: Statuses come from the same data as docs/ROADMAP.md. Numbers and economics stay subject to community governance.

cosmos-evm-migration.title: People's Blockchain testnet (EVM)
cosmos-evm-migration.summary: Growing the People's Blockchain testnet on EVM. Stage 1 (chain build) is underway; the current public testnet still runs on the OVN-derived node with read-only RPC.

genesis-snapshot-0x.title: State snapshot into genesis
genesis-snapshot-0x.summary: Export balances and accounts into a new chain genesis while keeping the same 0x addresses people already use.

solidity-protocol-modules.title: Solidity: factory, curve, AMM, NFT
solidity-protocol-modules.summary: Protocol modules already work on the testnet node; the target is audited Solidity on the People's Blockchain testnet, including a Uniswap V2-style AMM.

fee-split-model-a.title: Network fee split (Model A)
fee-split-model-a.summary: Validators 30%, community pool 25%, treasury 20%, liquidity & ecosystem 10%, growth pool 15%, burn 0%.

tokenomics-1b-ppl.title: 1 billion PPL supply
tokenomics-1b-ppl.summary: Fixed 1B PPL: years 1–4 at 0% inflation; validator pool 200M on a 6/5/5/4% schedule plus 30% of fees; launch rewards from the 35% community pool; from year 5 max 2%/year by vote; founders airdrop before sale at 1,000 verified people + multisig. Fee split 30/25/20/10/15/0 on /tokenomics and /how-it-works.

discover-feed.title: Project feed
discover-feed.summary: Public project cards, reactions, questions, and stats for communities building on People.

ai-token-icons.title: AI token icons
ai-token-icons.summary: Generate a token image when you launch.

evm-wallet-site-package.title: EVM wallet connections for the site
evm-wallet-site-package.summary: Read-only JSON-RPC (chain id 97401) is live; a dedicated MetaMask / Trust / WalletConnect package is next.

community-ai-agent-wallet.title: Community AI agent wallets
community-ai-agent-wallet.summary: Multisig treasury with spending limits, whitelists, freeze, and changes only by token vote — all actions visible in the explorer.

oz-contract-builder.title: Plain-language contract builder
oz-contract-builder.summary: Describe what you need; we assemble audited OpenZeppelin templates and help you deploy.

ai-anti-scam-guard.title: AI anti-scam guard
ai-anti-scam-guard.summary: Warnings before risky transfers and contracts, tuned for everyday users.

ai-governance-summaries.title: AI governance summaries
ai-governance-summaries.summary: Short, neutral explanations of on-chain votes on the site.

rewards-proof-of-humanity.title: Rewards with proof of humanity
rewards-proof-of-humanity.summary: Pay real contributors, not bots — building on participant registration and verified-human checks.

erc8004-x402-agents.title: ERC-8004 agents & x402 payments
erc8004-x402-agents.summary: On-chain agent registry and payment rails compatible with emerging agent standards.

no-agent-memecoins.title: No memecoins for agents
no-agent-memecoins.summary: Community AI agents are for useful automation, not meme token launches — formal policy pending approval.

site-wide-wallet-connect-modal.title: In-place wallet connect modal
site-wide-wallet-connect-modal.summary: Connect or create a wallet in a modal on any page — no redirect to a separate screen. Rolling out across the site.

cosmos-evm-smart-accounts.title: Smart accounts on the testnet
cosmos-evm-smart-accounts.summary: ERC-4337 or equivalent: sign in with Google, email, or a passkey; wallet created automatically with no seed phrase (optional key export). At signup, choose “Create wallet with Google/email” or “Connect your own”. Gasless: the first N transactions for newcomers paid by a paymaster from a community or project fund.

ai-monthly-community-report.title: Monthly AI community report
ai-monthly-community-report.summary: An automated monthly summary of project and network activity — metrics and highlights for communities.

discover-referral-growth-pool.title: Project feed referral links (Growth Pool)
discover-referral-growth-pool.summary: Each project card in the feed gets its own referral link, tied to Growth Pool referral rewards under Model A.

founders-stage1-founders-page.title: Million founders — stage 1: /founders
founders-stage1-founders-page.summary: Live verified counter, world map and country leaderboard, founder number, early-entry multipliers (Preliminary: 10k×5, 100k×3, 1M×1.5). Google sign-in + proof of humanity; no points without verification.

founders-stage2-points-antibot.title: Million founders — stage 2: points & anti-bot
founders-stage2-points-antibot.summary: Daily points for real actions on testnet (swap, feed, token, NFT, pool, vote) and Sybil-resistant scoring; referral points only after invitee is verified and acts.

founders-stage3-referral-growth-contract.title: Million founders — stage 3: on-chain registry & Growth share
founders-stage3-referral-growth-contract.summary: Founders registry on chain 97401; lifetime Growth Pool referral share (Preliminary 10% / 3%) — new contracts, founder-gated vs Beta 70/30.

founders-stage4-grants-mainnet-conversio.title: Million founders — stage 4: grants & mainnet conversion
founders-stage4-grants-mainnet-conversio.summary: Community-pool grants for projects that bring real people; 10k/100k/1M milestones; points to PPL from the community rewards bucket (Preliminary: 35% allocation, 20% upfront, 12-month active vest, +25% stake).

founders-stage5-ambassadors-ai-bot.title: Million founders — stage 5: ambassadors & AI bot
founders-stage5-ambassadors-ai-bot.summary: Top 50 referrers per country get ambassador pages; Telegram AI helper for sign-in and tasks (more channels later).

lavka-stage1-loyalty-qr.title: Lavka — stage 1: loyalty & checkout QR
lavka-stage1-loyalty-qr.summary: Small businesses create visit passes and bonuses via Google in minutes (no crypto jargon); QR redeem auto-enrolls customers as founders.

lavka-stage2-cross-tips-ambassador.title: Lavka — stage 2: cross-bonuses & tips
lavka-stage2-cross-tips-ambassador.summary: Seller ambassador share from Growth Pool; neighbouring-venue cross-bonuses; tip QR with Model A network fee split.

lavka-stage3-escrow-disputes.title: Lavka — stage 3: escrow & disputes
lavka-stage3-escrow-disputes.summary: Prepaid guarantees in escrow until an event or deadline; public reliability rating; disputes voted by verified people; personal data stays off-chain.

lavka-stage4-pilot-seller-ai.title: Lavka — stage 4: pilot & seller AI
lavka-stage4-pilot-seller-ai.summary: AI reminders for expiring passes and quiet hours; Batumi pilot (Preliminary: 10 venues, one category).

ai-group-buy-negotiation.title: AI group buying negotiation
ai-group-buy-negotiation.summary: Later track: AI negotiates on behalf of a buyer group — roadmap only, no implementation yet.

token-project-pages-lightpaper.title: Token project pages & lightpaper
token-project-pages-lightpaper.summary: Launch form captures goal, distribution, vesting, team and links; the site builds a project page with a tokenomics chart and short lightpaper (extendable to a white paper), PDF download and embed. Planning only.

mainnet-migration-snapshot-tokenomics.title: Mainnet migration via testnet snapshot
mainnet-migration-snapshot-tokenomics.summary: Move projects to mainnet using a testnet balance snapshot; each project confirms its tokenomics before migration. Planning only.

ambassador-promo-kit.title: Ambassador promo kit
ambassador-promo-kit.summary: Promo materials for ambassadors and active founders after the Million Founders launch. Planning only.
